definitions.explanation: A political or social attitude that values tradition and resists rapid change.
The act of maintaining equipment, systems, or facilities in good working order. Common in technical and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {保守|ほしゅ}{的|てき}な⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧だ。
examples.english: That's a conservative way of thinking.

notes: Two distinct usage domains. In politics, the opposite is ⟦{革新|かくしん}→革新：05617_kakushin⟧ (progressive/reform) or ⟦リベラル→リベラル：11707_riberaru⟧ (liberal). Common political collocations: {保守|ほしゅ}{党|とう} (conservative party), {保守|ほしゅ}{派|は} (conservative faction), {保守|ほしゅ}{的|てき} (conservative). In the technical/business sense, common collocations include {保守|ほしゅ}⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ (maintenance management), {保守|ほしゅ}⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧ (maintenance contract), and {保守|ほしゅ}⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧ (maintenance inspection). Also used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {保守|ほしゅ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to maintain).
